EXTRA UNIT COPY COSTS / GS37. Permanent required accounting entry. Troop and Other arithmetic remain logically separate but live directly on this single visible parent. Strike Team (10) and Breacher Team (10) remain the two independent Troop copy families. Twelve native non-Rare Other families retain their established copy accounting. rules.name: Patch Notes
rules.description:
## T'au 3.3.8

DRAFT BUILD — Phase 2 (battlesuit loadouts, including the XV104 Riptide). The Riptide and its Shielded Missile Drones are now selectable, with native empty optional Support System choices. Commander/Crisis/Broadside loadouts and full shared Support System descriptions remain under review. Do not distribute as a finished release.

## XV104 Riptide & Shielded Missile Drones (WIP implementation)
• Added the 300-point Riptide with two mandatory weapon choices, Shield Generator and two fixed Shielded Missile Drones with Missile Pods.
• Added two independent optional +30 Support System slots, which cannot select the same system, plus one optional +10 Positional Relay / Drone Controller slot. All three offer New Recruit's native (None) selection.

## XV8 Crisis Battlesuits
• Removed Unstoppable.
• Added one provisional optional +10 weapon choice, one independent +10 Support System choice, and optional +10 Iridium Armour to each model.

## XV8 Battlesuit Commander
• Updated the Commander loadout: two starting weapons, one optional +20 weapon, one optional +20 Support System, one independent +10 utility choice, optional +10 Iridium Armour and XV8/Coldstar/Enforcer configuration.

## XV88 Broadside Battlesuit
• Added two independent optional +20 Support System selections, and one separate optional +10 Positional Relay / Drone Controller selection.
• Flattened the Broadside Loadout Options presentation; existing weapon defaults, drones and +10 Seeker Missile are unchanged.

Full patch notes and rules can be found in the Reforged Discord Server:

https://discord.gg/BpjkaNmMVB

## Changelog (September 23rd)

• Presentation: removed the 🔗 icon from Leader Attachment association labels so roster exports show plain `Leader Attachment`.
• Presentation: standardized ◆ unit markers to the project-wide two-space format in roster exports.
• 420 Point Practice: now uses 0 Leader Points and Quick-equivalent Extra Unit Copy Cost allowances; LP-costing units are hidden unless already selected.

## Changelog (September 21st)

• Standardized Configuration ordering across the listbuilder.
• Presentation: standardized diamond unit markers.
• XV8 Crisis Battlesuits: cleaned the Additional Crisis Shas'ui Model checkbox presentation.

## Changelog (September 19th)

• Presentation: adopted the current emoji-enabled listbuilder presentation, including LP ⭐, 🏷️ Unit Abilities, 🧰 Loadout Options, and shared category icons.
• Unit Abilities: added all top-level Unit Ability names across the army.
• Added 420 Point Practice support.
• XV8 Commander configurations now show their matching Unit Abilities only when selected.
• Support Turrets retain their automatic informational counter and now show their Unit Ability profiles.

## Changelog (September 16th)

• Added source model-count suffixes across the army.
• Leader Points added to XV8 Battlesuit Commander and Cadre Fireblade; Ethereal remains 0 LP.
• XV8 Crisis Battlesuits: optional third suit now uses an Additional Model checkbox.
• Added the Support Turret counter and standardized optional Photon Grenade / Seeker Missile checkboxes.
• Recon and Hunter Pathfinder loadouts were rebuilt into clearer final-state model roles and weapon packages.

selectionEntries.comment: REV38 / GS41 — CRISIS LOADOUT INITIAL DRAFT: Two mandatory independently selectable weapons per Crisis Shas'ui are preserved, including Burst Cannon defaults and duplicate-weapon eligibility. Each suit now has one provisional optional +10 additional-weapon radio (default actual None), one +10 Support System choice (actual None by default), and its own optional once-only +10 Iridium Armour checkbox. The optional third Shas'ui retains its existing +50 Points Additional Model structure and receives identical individual equipment choices only when selected. The PDF says 'each time' for extra weapons but does not state an overall cap; one optional weapon per model is a WIP design choice for New Recruit inspection and needs confirmation. Full descriptions for Support Systems and the Broadside/Riptide additions remain pending.

selectionEntries.comment:
REV43 CURRENT RIPTIDE STRUCTURE (SOURCE: TAU 3.3.8 PDF). The existing REV33 Riptide identity and semantic equipment IDs have been restored. Fixed base cost 300 includes XV104 Riptide and two Shielded Missile Drones. Loadout Options presents two mandatory weapon choices and the mandatory Shield Generator directly, without a redundant Riptide model heading. The fixed two Shielded Missile Drones each carry a Missile Pod in their own section. Support Systems contains two independent optional +30 slots (same-named duplicates prohibited by constructive unit-level errors), then an independent optional +10 Positional Relay / Drone Controller slot. All three optional groups are native-empty radios: max one, no minimum, no default and no fake (None) entry. The names of intrinsic abilities are represented using shared name-only Unit Ability profiles; exact battlefield text is in the PDF.
REV33: Tau 3.3.8 new XV104 Riptide. A 300-point Vehicle/Titan including 2 Shielded Missile Drones with Missile Pods. Two mandatory mutually exclusive weapon selectors, mandatory Shield Generator, optional +30 Support Systems A/B (duplicates prohibited), independent +10 Positional Relay/Drone Controller selection. Rule/stat text lives in the army PDF. Other soft copy costs follow existing support unit accounting.

catalogue.comment:
REV43 / GS41 — XV104 RIPTIDE RESTORED AND REBUILT (WIP)
Restored the stable REV33 XV104 Riptide with its two Shielded Missile Drones, restructured Loadout Options without a repeated unit header, separated the two-drone equipment block and Support Systems, and replaced the REV33 literal None choices in all three support selectors with the proven native empty optional radio structure used by Imperial Guard and current Tau. Includes the two +30 support hardpoints, duplicate-system validation, one +10 utility selection and full Other-unit copy-cost accounting. Source: Tau 3.3.8 PDF. Commander/Crisis/Broadside loadouts and complete support-system descriptions are still WIP.

REV42 / GS41 — NATIVE EMPTY RADIO STATE (WIP)
Corrected all 12 optional new Tau radio selectors for Commander, Crisis suits and Broadside: removed literal (None) upgrade entries; each group now has maximum one selection and no minimum/default so New Recruit supplies its native empty choice without exporting a fictitious (None) wargear line. All real equipment choices, their IDs, prices and duplicate-Broadside-system error logic are preserved. Commander/Crisis/Broadside loadouts remain WIP; Riptide and full shared system descriptions are pending.

REV41 / GS41 — BROADSIDE DUPLICATE SUPPORT SYSTEM VALIDATION (WIP)
Added six unit-level constructive errors, each triggered only when both optional +20-point Broadside Support System slots select the same named system. The two slots remain independently selectable; the separate +10-point utility slot, price lists, defaults, and all other units are unchanged. New Recruit runtime check requested.

REV40 / GS41 — XV88 BROADSIDE EQUIPMENT INITIAL DRAFT
Built on REV39, preserving the Commander and the approved one-Support-System-per-Crisis-model layouts. Flattened the existing Broadside Loadout Options to match the newer single-model Commander style (removed only the redundant model-heading group, retaining its child weapon/drone selectors and IDs). Added two independent optional +20 Support System selections, one per Broadside hardpoint, with real (None) defaults and the six permitted systems from Tau 3.3.8. Added a separate optional +10 Positional Relay / Drone Controller selection with (None) default. Existing +10 Seeker Missile stays in Paid Wargear. No other unit mechanics or historical Changelog changes. XV104 Riptide and complete shared Support System descriptions are still pending. Do not distribute as a finished release.
